I am too old to carry heavy bags of chemical fertilizer, and at my age with no schooling, I do not know how to use them properly. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last season and put cow manure from my animals on this small plot to give it strength. My children and grandchildren will help with the digging, weeding, and harvest, so we do not need to pay hired workers — the rains in Mbeya are usually good enough that I do not need irrigation either.
